test_title: SSC CPO 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On 11 Nov 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Evaluate frac{sin 54circ}{cos 36circ}+frac{sec 46circ}{operatorname{cosec} 44circ}
solution:
**Formula used:**

sin ( 90 - theta ) = costheta , sec ( 90 - theta ) = cosectheta 

**Calculation:**

sin54^circ/cos36^circ + sec46^circ/cosec44^circ 

As, we know that sin( 90 - theta ) = costheta , sec (90 - theta ) = cosectheta 

⇒ sin ( 90 - 36 ) /cos36 + sec( 90 - 44 ) /cosec44

⇒ cos36/cos36 + cosec44/cosec44 = 1 + 1 = 2 

**Hence, the required value is 2 .**
